title: "Aakriti's Animint Gallery"
output: 
  html_document:
    self_contained: false
---

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(kableExtra)

# 1. Read data
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv')

# 2. Build CLEAN HTML img tags
# We use 'single quotes' for the HTML and 'double quotes' for R
img_tags <- paste0("<img src='[https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/)", 
                   trimws(dt$viz_owner_repo), 
                   "@main/Capture.PNG' width='200'>")

# 3. Create the table data
display_df <- data.frame(
  Screenshot = img_tags,
  Project = dt$title,
  Links = paste0("<a href='[https://aakritixyz.github.io/](https://aakritixyz.github.io/)", 
                 gsub("aakritixyz/", "", dt$viz_owner_repo), 
                 "/'>Demo</a>")
)

# 4. Render as HTML (escape = FALSE is the secret!)
kable(display_df, format = "html", escape = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
